description: Research Episode state machine for the Pointfire Research Executive OS. Minimum states are INTAKE -> QUESTION_FROZEN -> EVIDENCE_GATHERING -> ANALYSIS -> CHALLENGE -> REVISION -> CANDIDATE_COMPLETE, plus five alternative states. A report file or elapsed time MUST NEVER alone cause a terminal transition. CANDIDATE_COMPLETE is NOT a success terminal; it requires review gates before any publication claim.

INTAKE.definition: Episode created; research question and strategy pack not yet frozen.

QUESTION_FROZEN.definition: Research question and question version frozen; scope, population, temporal and outcome definitions captured.

EVIDENCE_GATHERING.definition: Collecting primary sources, full text, methods, data and code; building the claim/evidence obligation graph.

ANALYSIS.definition: Recomputing results, reproducing analyses, building definition crosswalks, comparing populations/denominators.

CHALLENGE.definition: Searching negative/replication/null/contradictory evidence, methodological critique, alternative mechanisms and adversarial review.

REVISION.definition: Revising candidate claims, claim ceilings and obligation statuses in response to analysis and challenge outcomes.

CANDIDATE_COMPLETE.definition: Candidate claims and evidence packet assembled and ready for the review gates. NOT a success terminal; publication requires claim-ceiling review and owner/GPT acceptance.

BLOCKED.definition: A verifiable source/data/access blocker prevents progress; recorded with evidence, not merely elapsed time.

INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_COMPLETE.definition: Honest null / reliable insufficient-evidence completion. A valid terminal-style outcome that does NOT claim a positive finding.

ESCALATED_TO_GPT_OWNER.definition: Mandatory human (GPT/owner) escalation triggered; episode waits for external adjudication.

PAUSED_RESUMABLE.definition: Budget or interruption boundary reached; full resumable checkpoint written to the append-only event log.

REOPENED.definition: A previously closed/paused/episode re-activated for further work.

transition_invariants: Transitions are validated against allowed_next; any other transition is rejected.
No transition may be triggered solely by a report file, word count, elapsed time or round count.
CANDIDATE_COMPLETE cannot transition to any success terminal without review_gates_passed and owner_gpt_acceptance.
Every transition appends one immutable event to the episode event log with provenance and timestamp.
